channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gayle Benson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gayle Benson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Gayle Benson
item.description:
“First and foremost, I want to thank Mrs. Benson for giving me the honor and privilege to lead the Pelicans basketball operations group,”

Joe Dumars on Gayle Benson, Apr 16, 2025. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Gayle Benson
item.description:
In particular,Fertitta said he would like to purchase the team he grew up rooting for: the New Orleans Saints.

“I’ve always loved the New Orleans Saints, but (owner Gayle Benson) won’t sell them right now,”

Tilman Fertitta on Gayle Benson, Dec 11, 2024. Source: Business News.

item.title: Dennis Lauscha on Gayle Benson
item.description:
Dennis Lauscha, the president of the Pelicans and Saints, had a blunt response to talk of moving the team.

“There’s absolutely no way — not on my watch, not on Mrs. Benson’s watch,”

Dennis Lauscha on Gayle Benson, Oct 1, 2021. Source: New Orleans Times-Picayune.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Gayle Benson
item.description:
Scott Kushner:Gentry:

“Mrs. Benson is going to make this thing a success. She’s 100 percent committed to doing everything we possibly can to making this a championship team. As long as that’s the case, I love being here.”

Alvin Gentry on Gayle Benson, May 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @ScottDKushner.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Gayle Benson
item.description:
Alvin Gentry on Gayle Benson's visit with the team this morning:

“Obviously, we think the world of her. We don't have any doubt that it's going to be a smooth transition and everything is going to be at a very high level and a first-class level.”

Alvin Gentry on Gayle Benson, Mar 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Mike Bass on Tom Benson, Gayle Benson
item.description:
Scott Kushner:NBA Spokesman Mike Bass’ said this on the #Pelicans ownership situation:

“As we mourn the loss of Tom Benson, we know the New Orleans Pelicans are on strong and stable footing as Gayle Benson,currently the team’s Alternate Governor, assumes control of the franchise.”

Mike Bass on Tom Benson, Gayle Benson, Mar 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @ScottDKushner.
